description: Shell script providing compatibility wrappers for /sbin/uci, including functions for loading, setting, reverting, toggling, adding, removing, and committing UCI configuration data.

methods.name: uci_load
methods.description: Loads UCI configuration data for a specified package.

methods.name: uci_set_default
methods.description: Sets default configuration for a package if not already set.

methods.name: uci_revert_state
methods.description: Reverts UCI configuration state to previous.

methods.name: uci_toggle_state
methods.description: Reverts and then sets UCI configuration state.

methods.name: uci_add_list
methods.description: Adds a value to a UCI list option.

methods.name: uci_get
methods.description: Gets a UCI configuration value with optional default.

methods.name: uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new UCI configuration section or item.

methods.name: uci_remove_list
methods.description: Removes a value from a UCI list option.

methods.name: uci_revert
methods.description: Reverts UCI configuration to previous state.
